meta.description: SOP §7 — generates the team-wide welcome announcement and emails it to the Onboarding Lead to paste into Teams. Until Teams API access exists, this is paste-friendly text. Triggered by POST /webhook/onb-group-chat-announce. After import, replace `REPLACE_ME` Gmail credential ID, then activate. Env: N8N_GROUP_CHAT_ANNOUNCE_URL.
